pages.title: Attunement Liquid
pages.text:
A bottle remembers which ore it was brewed from, and that is what the detector is attuned to.  
A millibucket is **one ore reported**, the same for every material, so the tank is simply how many finds you are carrying.

pages.title: What a bottle is worth
pages.text:
What differs is what a bottle is worth.

- Coal, Copper, Zinc, Tin: 165.
- Lapis: 90.
- Iron, Gold, Quartz, Amethyst, Uraninite: 45.
- Diamond, Emerald: 25.
- Ancient Debris: 12.

pages.title: Pouring it in
pages.text: Pour one in by holding the bottle in your main hand and the detector in your off hand, then holding right click.
